remgard_drunk2.m: *burp* This is the best place in all of the northern lands!

remgard_drunk2_2.m: Oh, hello there. *burp* Kid, I tell you, don't go looking for trouble even if you think you can handle it.

remgard_drunk2_3.m: I did once, and ended up in those horrid caverns of Mount Galmore.

remgard_drunk2_4.m: That place twists your mind. I tell you, don't go there, even if you think you want to!
r: Mount Galmore twists your mind? Oh, I see. You mean Undertell?

remgard_drunk2_5.m: [burp] What was that? Were you saying something?
